kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Healthcare STERIS : consommables, services, équipements capital pour hôpitaux. Segment dominant ~71% du CA FY25. Forte croissance porté par services et consommables, équipement capital plus volatile.
kpis.description_en: STERIS Healthcare segment revenue: consumables, services, capital equipment for hospitals. Dominant segment ~71% of FY25 sales. Strong growth led by services and consumables; capital equipment more volatile.
kpis._specific_to: STERIS hospital infection prevention core franchise

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Life Sciences : consommables, services, équipements pour fabricants pharma. Recul FY25 lié à cession CECS. ~10% du CA. Sensible aux cycles capex pharma.
kpis.description_en: Life Sciences segment revenue: consumables, services, capital equipment for pharma manufacturers. FY25 decline driven by CECS divestiture. ~10% of sales. Sensitive to pharma capex cycles.

kpis_story.description_fr: EPA + FDA renforcent règles EtO emissions 2024-2026. STERIS leader investit compliance + alternative tech (X-ray, e-beam). Compétiteurs out, parts marché up.
kpis_story.description_en: EPA + FDA tightening EtO emissions rules 2024-2026. STERIS leader investing compliance + alternative tech (X-ray, e-beam). Competitors out, market share up.

_notes: STERIS = sterilization + infection prevention leader healthcare/AST.
